t: What Does The Name Ruier Mean?
s: As a given name, Ruier is encountered in modern Chinese pinyin romanization for 瑞尔 or 睿尔, typically interpreted as “auspicious” or “perspicacious” plus the phono-semantic element “er” (“you/son”), yielding meanings like “auspicious one” or “wise one.” Variations recorded or inferred across languages include Ruyer, Rouyer, Royer (French), Reuer/Reier/Reyer/Reyer (German), Reiher (German nickname-to-surname), and Ruyer/Roier in medieval Iberian texts paralleling Roger/Ruier spellings.
